brief:
Israeli forces killed two Palestinians, including a woman, in an attack on Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Middle East Eye reported, citing Wafa news agency and a medical source.

The bombardment struck the city as Israel continues operations across the territory. Khan Younis, a major population center in Gaza's south, has faced repeated Israeli military actions during the ongoing conflict.
dek: Israel kills two Palestinians in attack on Gaza's Khan Younis Israeli bombardment of southern Gaza's Khan Younis city has killed two people, including a woman, Wafa reports citing a medical source.
title: Israel kills two Palestinians in Khan Younis bombardment
